So I'd like to go around and hear from each regular participant and the meeting coordinator: please state directly any approved workplace arrangement or other constraint that affects the charter, even if it's normally handled through a manager. That way I can make sure the revised operating charter and support arrangements work for everyone. Who'd like to start?
